notes: «رُوِيَ» is passive and names no transmitter, so the chain starts at Mu'awiya
«قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» — the Imam is the last link, imam_in_text (ruling 2); the blessing is left out
The second «قُلْتُ» is Mu'awiya's further question inside the saying, not a link

fixes.reason: RWY reads the passive verb رُوِيَ as a transmitter; the text has no name before معاوية بن عمار.
